'''Vorse Tabarith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tabarith was a native of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] where he owned and operated several [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[Resort/Legends|resorts]], which were little more than fronts for his racketeering and bookie enterprises. He was married to, and spent much time entertaining his wife, [[Aris Shen]]. At his wife's urging, he attended an auction to acquire the valuable [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], unaware that his [[Arend Shen|father-in-law]] and wife were planning to steal both the [[Corusca gem|gem]] and the money paid for its purchase.
